title: Power-Restore Device Boot Storm
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shelly:status boot_reason=poweron
| bin _time span=10m
| stats count as devices_restarted by _time
| where devices_restarted>3
| sort - _time
description: Detects bursts of devices rebooting because of power restoration, giving you a useful audit trail for short outages you might otherwise miss.
value: Tiny power blips can explain a surprising number of weird household issues; a boot storm graph links those mysteries back to infrastructure instability.
implementation: Forward device boot reasons from Shelly or similar endpoints; alert when several devices report a power-on reboot within minutes.
visualization: Timeline of clustered power-on boots across smart devices.
grandmaExplanation: It compares when a small power cut or power blip made a bunch of smart devices restart together.
